title: Odd majority influence bound
statement: For every integer $m\ge 0$, define the odd-majority influence by $I_m=\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$. Then $I_m^2\le \dfrac{2((2m+1)+1)}{\pi(2m+1)^2}$.
